limits: Simulator and fixture testing; no physical hardware or live-service certification.
Primary BEFORE is original beta 97153048. Supplemental BEFORE is 218b5172; these are different baselines.
Final 170% images are genuine simulator captures, not resized default images.
Full routes and specialized checks are preserved in capture-evidence.zip; PDFs select representative scenes.

post_supplement.note: All 192 historical archive image hashes verified. The 108 historical final images explicitly carry dirty=true and are not used as clean-source proof. This PDF pairs original clean supplemental BEFORE frames with clean FINAL frames from matrix run 37008549549.
